resources.string: The real alert, marked as a test. Try it with a mode such as Bedtime on to hear what it lets through.
Sent: check your notifications. It goes away by itself in 2 min.
Sukrara shows your glucose or someone else\'s, alerts you when you need it and shares yours with the people you choose.

Choose whose glucose and where it comes from, allow what alerts need, connect it and check your alerts: that is all Sukrara needs. Followers, insulin pens and your history are optional. You can leave any step for later.
Sukrara isn\'t a medical device: values can be wrong, late or missing, and alerts may not ring. Check your sensor\'s app or a meter, and ask your doctor, before you decide on a treatment.
A child, a partner or a friend.
You can change it any time in Settings › Source.
Where does your glucose come from?
Where does their glucose come from?
From another Sukrara · internet or Bluetooth nearby
Sukrara connects to the sensor itself, so no other app may hold it. The history on this phone stays.
Sukrara stops connecting to the sensor and reads Juggluco on this phone, which must run with its web server on (Settings › Web server). The sensor’s pairing and the history stay.
Sukrara reads Juggluco on this phone, which must run with its web server on (Settings › Web server). The history on this phone stays.
Sukrara shows what another Sukrara shares, once it accepts your request. The history on this phone stays.
In Juggluco, turn on its web server (Settings › Web server). Sukrara reads it on this phone; nothing leaves it.
Waiting for the first reading from Juggluco. No alert can ring until one arrives.

You chose “%1$s”. This deletes what this phone kept from before: %2$s, %3$s. It can’t be undone.

Start a new Libre 3, take over the one you wear with your LibreView account, or read it from Juggluco.
Not monitoring: no sensor yet. No alert can ring until a reading arrives.
Nothing is saved until you confirm.
Keep the order: very low below low, low below high, high below very high, very high below extremely high.
Restore your followers with your recovery code, or start fresh with new invites.

Your followers move to this phone: the phone that shared until now stops reaching them. Do this once your glucose arrives on this phone.

Stop sharing on the other phone, then retry.
Make an invite for one person. They ask to follow; you allow them.

Sharing over the internet is off. An invite link and the request it brings travel over the internet: turn it on to invite someone, or use Pair nearby in Settings › Sharing.
Turn on sharing over the internet
Invite QR code. The link is below.
Send them the link: they open it in Sukrara on their phone or Mac. Sukrara on another phone or a Mac can also scan this code.
This link works once, until %1$s. Send it only to %2$s: whoever opens it first can ask to follow you, and you still allow them. It holds no key to your glucose.
This link works once, until %1$s. Send it only to the person you invite: whoever opens it first can ask to follow you, and you still allow them. It holds no key to your glucose.
Nobody else can use this invite now. Allow or deny their request.
They see your glucose on their phone or Mac. You can remove them any time in Settings › Sharing.
Nobody can use this invite any more. Create another one to invite someone.
Nobody used it. Create another one to invite someone.
Your glucose and trend, your alerts, your treatments and your sensor\'s time left, end-to-end encrypted. You can remove them at any time.
If you allow, they see your glucose until you remove them.
Invite someone and they can see your glucose on their phone or Mac.

Your password manager didn\'t save it
Nothing was saved. Try again, or choose another password manager in Android\'s settings.
Nothing changed: the copy it saved on %1$s stays there unless you deleted it. Try again, or choose another password manager in Android\'s settings.
Recovery code copied. Paste it now somewhere you keep important things, away from its password.
The relays only hold your follower list, encrypted. Without the password manager entry or the recovery code nobody can restore it, not even you.
Restore another identity or start fresh. Every follower needs a new invite.

From its recovery code or your password manager. Its followers move to this phone.

Replaced. %1$d followers of the restored identity follow this phone now.

So they know who is asking. Optional.

Open · closes in %1$s. On their phone: Find phones nearby, when joining.
Asked with Pair nearby: any phone or Mac in Bluetooth range can ask. Allow only if their screen shows this same code.
Same code. Waiting for %1$s to allow you.

The codes didn\'t match, so nothing was shared. Try again next to their phone.
No link? If they\'re next to you, ask them to turn on Pair nearby (Settings › Sharing) and find their phone over Bluetooth.
Looking for phones with Pair nearby on…

Point the camera at the QR code on their phone. It\'s read on this phone: nothing is recorded or sent.
Camera view for the QR code
Sukrara needs the camera to read the QR code. Nothing is recorded or sent. You can also paste the link or pick a picture of the code.
Camera access is off for Sukrara. Turn it on in the app\'s settings, or paste the link or pick a picture of the code.

Invite read. Add your name if you like and tap Join.
No Sukrara invite QR code in that picture. Try a sharper screenshot, or paste the link.
Sukrara is your alarm, and the way phones share glucose changes from time to time: an old version can stop sharing or following until it\'s updated.
Once a day, Sukrara asks GitHub whether there\'s a new version.
A quiet notification tells you. Nothing installs until you tap Update, unless you also turn on automatic installs in Settings › About.
Updates come straight from Sukrara\'s GitHub releases, outside any app store, so no store checks them. Sukrara installs only a file signed with its own key.
On: Sukrara checks for updates once a day. You can change it any time in Settings › About.
Off until you turn it on. You can change it any time in Settings › About.
Sukrara starts with an empty history. Bring back the last 90 days from Tidepool, LibreView or a file you exported from the earlier app, so your graph, reports and last doses are there again.
Nothing is counted twice: your sensor\'s own readings win, and importing again only adds what is missing. You can also do it later in Settings › Share with apps › Import history.
The rest is optional. Set it up now, or later from Settings.
Is this phone rooted? With root, your glucose can show as text in the status bar while the notification keeps the graph.
You can change it later in Settings › Status bar & notification.
With a smart insulin pen such as NovoPen 6 or NovoPen Echo Plus, hold it to the back of the phone after you inject: Sukrara logs the dose.
I don\'t use a smart pen
Pens are read. Hold one to the back of the phone, unlocked, from any app.

Sukrara stops reading the sensor and reads LibreLinkUp. To give the sensor back to the Libre app, scan it there: any day of its life. The pairing and the history on this phone stay.

Use the LibreLinkUp account the Libre app shares your glucose with. To share with yourself: in the Libre app, Menu › Connected apps › LibreLinkUp, invite your own email, then accept the invite in LibreLinkUp once.
Use your LibreLinkUp account: the one their Libre app invited.
LibreLinkUp is Abbott’s and isn’t made for Sukrara: it may change or stop any day. Sukrara tells you when it does.
Sharing with your own email? It’s the account Sukrara already signs in to LibreView with.
LibreLinkUp refused this email or password
LibreLinkUp needs you first: open the LibreLinkUp app, sign in and accept the new terms. Then try again.
Too many attempts: LibreLinkUp asks to wait a few minutes. Sukrara doesn’t retry by itself, so your account isn’t locked longer.
No one shares glucose with this account yet. In the Libre app: Menu › Connected apps › LibreLinkUp, invite this email, accept the invite in LibreLinkUp, then try again.
No answer from LibreLinkUp. Try again in a moment.
LibreView is down for maintenance, so LibreLinkUp can\'t sign in now. Sign in once it\'s back, usually within the hour, or choose another source.
This account follows several people. Pick the one Sukrara shows; you can change it in Settings › Source.
Waiting for the first reading from LibreLinkUp…
Your last 12 hours came with LibreLinkUp. For more, bring back 90 days from LibreView, where the Libre app uploads.
